Chapter headingVol. 1, p. 34

Interpretation of [the time] between the maghrib and isha prayers.

‌ ‌تفسير ما بين المغرب والعشاء

No. 70Vol. 1, p. 34

70. He said: Hafs ibn Maysara informed me, from al-Kirmani, that he said on the words of ⦗p. 35⦘ God: "and he entered the city at a time of inattention by its people": He said, between the maghrib and isha.

70 - قال: وأخبرني حفص بن ميسرة عن الكرماني أنه قال في قول ⦗ص: 35⦘ الله: {ودخل المدينة على حين غفلةٍ من أهلها}، قال: ما بين المغرب والعشاء.

No. 71Vol. 1, p. 35

71. He said: Hafs ibn Maysara informed me, from Abu al-Hasan, that he said, on the words of God: "They are not all the same: among the People of the Book is an upright community who recite the verses of God during the hours of the night while they prostrate, who believe in God and the Last Day and command what is right," the whole verse: He said, between the maghrib and isha.

71 - قال: وأخبرني حفص بن ميسرة عن أبي الحسن أنه قال في قول الله: {ليسوا سواء من أهل الكتاب أمةٌ قائمةٌ يتلون آيات الله أناء الليل وهم يسجدون يؤمنون بالله واليوم الآخر ويأمرون بالمعروف}، الآية كلها، قال: ما بين المغرب والعشاء.

No. 72Vol. 1, p. 35

72. And Hafs ibn Maysara informed me, from al-Kirmani, that he said, on the words of God: "and she was among the devoutly obedient": He said, between the maghrib and isha.

72 - وأخبرني حفص بن ميسرة عن الكرماني أنه قال: في قول الله: {وكانت من القانتين}، قال: ما بين المغرب والعشاء.

No. 73Vol. 1, p. 35

73. He said: Hafs ibn Maysara also informed me, from Abu Marwan, from Abu Tayba ⦗p. 36⦘ from Abd Allah ibn Umar, that he said: It is due from God that for whoever devotes himself in the mosque after the maghrib until the isha, speaking only the Qur'an, supplication, or prayer, two palaces will be built for him in Paradise, the breadth of each of the two palaces being a hundred years, and between them will be planted plantings such that, if he hosted all the people of the world, it would hold them. If he recites two hundred verses, he will be given a qintar in Paradise; the qintar is twelve hundred ounces [uqiyya], and the uqiyya is [the distance] between the sky and the earth.

73 - قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي حَفْصُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ أَيْضًا عَنْ أَبِي مَرْوَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي طَيْبَةَ ⦗ص: 36⦘ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: حَقٌّ عَلَى اللَّهِ مَنْ عَكَفَ نَفْسَهُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ بَعْدَ الْمَغْرِبِ إِلَى الْعِشَاءِ، لا يَتَكَلَّمُ إِلا بقرآنٍ أَوْ دعاءٍ أَوْ صلاةٍ، أَنْ يُبْنَى لَهُ قَصْرَانِ فِي الْجَنَّةِ، عَرْضُ كُلِّ قصرٍ مِنْهُمَا مِائَةُ عَامٍ، وَيُغْرَسُ لَهُ مَا بَيْنَهُمَا غِرَاسٌ لَوْ أَضَافَهُ جَمِيعَ أَهْلِ الدُّنْيَا كُلَّهُمْ لَوَسِعَهُمْ؛ فإن قرأ مائتي آية أعطي قنطاراً فِي الْجَنَّةِ، وَالْقِنْطَارُ أَلْفٌ وَمِائَتَا وُقِيَّةٍ، وَالْوُقِيَّةُ ما بين السماء إلى الأرض.

No. 74Vol. 1, p. 36

74. He said: Hafs informed me, from Ayyub, that he said: Whoever devotes himself in the mosque after the maghrib until the isha without speaking is as if he followed one military campaign with another.

74 - قال: وأخبرني حفص عن أيوب أنه قال: من عكف نفسه في المسجد بعد المغرب إلى العشاء لا يتكلم كأنما عقب غزوة بعد غزوةٍ.

No. 75Vol. 1, p. 36

75. He said: Hafs informed us, from Jabir the ascetic, that he [said]: Whoever prays four rak'as after the late isha prayer, reciting in each rak'a the Fatihat al-Kitab, the Throne Verse, and fifteen times "Say, He is God, One," that is ⦗p. 37⦘ sixty times in four rak'as, will rise from that sitting forgiven.

75 - قال: وأخبرنا حفص عن جابر الزاهد أنه [قال]: من صلى أربع ركعات بعد العشاء الأخرة يقرأ في كل ركعةٍ منهن بفاتحة الكتاب، وآية الكرسي، وخمس عشرة مرة: {قل هو الله أحد}، فتلك ⦗ص: 37⦘ ستون مرة في أربع ركعاتٍ، قام من مجلسه ذلك مغفورا له.

No. 76Vol. 1, p. 37

76. He said: Hafs informed me, from Zayd ibn Aslam, on the words of God: "And man says, 'When I am dead, will I be brought forth alive?'" That is about those who deny the resurrection. God says: "Does man not remember that We created him before, when he was nothing? So by your Lord," O Muhammad, "We will surely gather them," the people who say this, those who deny the resurrection, "and the devils; then We will bring them around Hell on their knees; then We will draw out from every sect those most defiant toward the Most Merciful," those who deny the resurrection; "and there is none of you," O people who say this, "but will come to it; that is upon your Lord a final decree. Then We will save those who feared God," so they will not come to it; "and We will leave the wrongdoers in it on their knees."

76 - قال: وأخبرني حفص عن زيد بن أسلم في قول الله: {ويقول الإنسان أإذا ما مت لسوف أخرج حيا}، وذلك في الذين ينكرون البعث، يقول الله: {أولا يذكر الإنسان أنا خلقناه من قبل ولم يك شيئا فوربك}، يا محمد، {لنحشرنهم}، أهل هذا القول، المكذبين بالبعث، {والشياطين ثم لنحضرنهم حول جهنم جثيا ثم لننزعن من كل شيعةٍ أيهم أشد على الرحمن عتيا}، المكذبين بالبعث، {وإن منكم}، يا أهل هذا القول، {إلا واردها كان على ربك حتما مقضيا ثم ننجي الذين اتقوا}، فلا يردونها، {ونذر الظالمين فيها جثياً}.

No. 77Vol. 1, p. 37

77. He said: Hafs informed me, from Zayd ibn Aslam, on the words of God: "He knows the secret and what is more hidden": He said, He knows the secrets of the servants and what is more hidden, His own secret, which is not known.

77 - قال: وأخبرني حفص عن زيد بن أسلم في قول الله: {يعلم السر وأخفى}، قال: يعلم أسرار العباد وأخفى سره فلا يعلم.

No. 78Vol. 1, p. 37

78. He said: Hafs informed me, from Ibn Ajlan, who said: When this verse was revealed ⦗p. 38⦘ to the Messenger of God, "Is one whose breast God has expanded to Islam, so that he is upon a light from his Lord...?" the Companions of the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, said: "Does the breast expand?" He said: "Yes. When God puts light into it, it expands and widens." They said: "Is there a sign by which that is known?" He said: "Turning away from the abode of delusion, turning toward the abode of permanence, and preparing for death before death comes."

78 - قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي حَفْصٌ عَنِ ابْنِ عَجْلانَ قَالَ: لما أنزلت هَذِهِ الآيَةُ ⦗ص: 38⦘ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: {أَفَمَنْ شَرَحَ اللَّهُ صَدْرَهُ لِلإِسْلامِ فَهُوَ عَلَى نورٍ مِنْ ربه}، قال أصحاب رسول الله عليه السلام: أو ينشرح الصَّدْرُ، قَالَ: نَعَمْ، إِذَا جَعَلَ اللَّهُ فِيهِ النُّورَ انْشَرَحَ وَانْفَسَحَ، قَالُوا: فَهَلْ لِذَلِكَ علامةٌ يُعْرَفُ بِهَا، قَالَ: التَّجَافِي عَنْ دَارِ الْغُرُورِ، وَالإِنَابَةُ إِلَى دَارِ الْخُلُودِ، وَالإِعْدَادُ لِلْمَوْتِ قَبْلَ الموت.

No. 79Vol. 1, p. 38

79. He said: Sufyan ibn Uyayna related to me, from Khalid ibn Abi Karima, from Abd Allah ibn al-Miswar, from the Messenger of God, to the same effect.

79 - قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنِي سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ أَبِي كَرِيمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْمِسْوَرِ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ بِنَحْوِ ذَلِكَ أَيْضًا.

No. 80Vol. 1, p. 38

80. And Hafs ibn Maysara informed us, from Ubada ibn Kathir, on the words of God: "Indeed, the rising by night is more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words": He said, between the maghrib and isha.

80 - وأخبرنا حفص بن ميسرة عن عبادة بن كثير في قول الله: {إن ناشئة الليل هي أشد وطئا وأقوم قيلا}، قال: ما بين المغرب والعشاء.

No. 81Vol. 1, p. 38

81. He said: Shabib ibn Said informed me, from Aban ibn Abi Ayyash, from Muslim ⦗p. 39⦘ ibn Abi Imran, from Ubayd Allah ibn Umar ibn al-Khattab, who said: He came to Ibn Masud on a Thursday evening as he was admonishing his companions. He said: I said, "Abu Abd al-Rahman, what is the straight path?" He said: "Nephew, the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, left us at its beginning, and its end is in Paradise. On its right are paths and on its left are paths, and on every path are men calling to everyone who passes by them, 'Come here, come here.' Whoever goes with them, they bring him down to the Fire, and whoever keeps to the main road, they bring him to Paradise."

81 - قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي شَبِيبُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبَانِ بن أبي عياش، عن مسلم ⦗ص: 39⦘ ابن أبي عمران، عن عبيد الله بن عمر بن الخطاب قال: أتى ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ عَشِيَّةَ خَمِيسٍ وَهُوَ يُذَكِّرُ أَصْحَابَهُ، قَالَ: فَقُلْتُ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، مَا الصراط المستقيم، قال: يا ابن أَخِي، تَرَكَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي أَدْنَاهُ وَطَرْفُهُ فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَعَنْ يَمِينِهِ جَوَادٌ، وَعَنْ شِمَالِهِ جَوَادٌ، وَعَلَى كُلِّ جَوَادٍ رجالٌ يَدْعُونَ كُلَّ مَنْ مَرَّ بِهِمْ: هَلُمَّ لَكَ، هَلُمَّ لَكَ، فَمَنْ أَخَذَ مَعَهُمْ وَرَدُوا بِهِ النَّارَ، وَمَنْ لَزِمَ الطَّرِيقَ الأَعْظَمَ وَرَدُوا بِهِ الْجَنَّةَ.

No. 82Vol. 1, p. 39

82. He said: Shabib ibn Said informed me, from Aban ibn Abi Ayyash, from Tawus, from Ibn Abbas, who said: The people of Ad had a valley; when rain came from the direction of that valley and clouds approached them from that side, that year would be fertile and known to them [as such]. So God sent the punishment upon them from the direction of that valley. Hud kept calling them and saying, "The punishment has overshadowed you." They said, "You lie. This is a cloud bringing us rain." Then the wind descended and swept away the shepherds. It would pass over a man with his sheep and shepherds so that he recognized them, and then it would lift them up into ⦗p. 40⦘ the sky until it cast them into the sea. Then it swept away the houses until it made them "like decayed bones."

82 - قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي شَبِيبُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبَانِ بن أبي عياش، عن طاؤوس، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ: كَانَ وادٍ لِقَوْمِ عَادٍ كَانَ إِذَا أُمْطِرُوا مِنْ نَحْوِ ذَلِكَ الْوَادِي وَأَتَاهُمُ الْغَيْمُ مِنْ قِبَلِهِ كَانَ ذَلِكَ العام خصب متعالم فِيهِمْ، فَبَعَثَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْعَذَابَ مِنْ قِبَلِ ذَلِكَ الْوَادِي، فَجَعَلَ هُودُ يَدْعُوهُمْ وَيَقُولُ: إِنَّ الْعَذَابَ قَدْ أَظَلَّكُمْ، فَيَقُولُونَ: كَذَبْتَ، هَذَا عَارِضٌ مُمْطِرُنَا؛ فَنَزَلَتِ الرِّيحُ فَنَسَفَتِ الرُّعَاةَ فَجَعَلَتْ تَمُرُّ عَلَى الرَّجُلِ بِغَنَمِهِ وَرُعَاتِهِ حَتَّى يَعْرِفَهَا، ثُمَّ يُحَلَّقُ بِهِمْ فِي ⦗ص: 40⦘ السَّمَاءِ حَتَّى تَقْذِفَهُمْ فِي الْبَحْرِ، ثُمَّ نَسَفَتِ الْبُيُوتَ حَتَّى جَعَلَتْهُمْ {كَالرَّمِيمِ}.

No. 83Vol. 1, p. 40

83. He said: Shabib informed me, from Abu al-Jawza, from Ibn Abbas, who said: The Messenger of God, peace be upon him, said: "If God had shown mercy to anyone of the people of Noah, He would have shown mercy to a woman who, when she saw the water, took her child and climbed the mountain. When the water reached her she climbed with him onto her shoulders. When the water reached her shoulders she put her child on her head. When the water reached her head she raised her child with her hands. If God had shown mercy to any of them, He would have shown mercy to this woman."

83 - قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي شَبِيبٌ عَنْ أَبِي الْجَوْزَاءِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: لَوْ رَحِمَ اللَّهُ مِنْ قَوْمِ نُوحٍ أَحَدًا لَرَحِمَ امْرَأَةً، لَمَّا رَأَتِ الْمَاءَ حَمَلَتْ وَلَدَهَا، ثُمَّ صَعِدَتِ الْجَبَلَ، فَلَمَّا بَلَغَهَا الْمَاءُ صَعِدَتْ بِهِ عَلَى مَنْكِبَيْهَا، فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ الْمَاءُ مَنْكِبَيْهَا وَضَعَتْ وَلَدَهَا عَلَى رَأْسِهَا، فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ الْمَاءُ رَأْسَهَا رَفَعَتْ وَلَدَهَا بِيَدَيْهَا، فَلَوْ رَحِمَ اللَّهُ مِنْهُمْ أَحَدًا لَرَحِمَ هَذِهِ المرأة.

No. 84Vol. 1, p. 40

84. And Shabib informed me, from Aban, from Anas ibn Malik, from the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, that he said: Sura al-Hajj was revealed to him while he was on a journey, with his companions taking their evening meal scattered apart. He raised his voice with it and called out: "O people, fear your Lord. Indeed, the quaking of the Hour is a terrible thing. On the Day you see it, every nursing mother will forget what she was nursing, and every pregnant woman will deliver her burden, and you will see ⦗p. 41⦘ the people drunk though they are not drunk, but the punishment of God is severe." His companions gathered around him, and he said to them: "Do you know what day that is? It is the day when God says to Adam, 'O Adam, send forth a contingent for the Fire from your sons and daughters.' He says, 'My Lord, from how many?' He says, 'From every thousand, nine hundred and ninety-nine to the Fire and one to Paradise.'" When the people heard that, they were dismayed and it weighed heavily on them. When the Prophet, peace be upon him, saw what they felt, he said: "Rejoice, for you are among two creations that were never with anything without increasing it: Gog and Magog, who 'descend from every elevation.' You are among the people only like a mark on the foreleg of an animal or like a mole on the side of a camel." Then he said: "I hope that those of my community who enter will be a quarter of the people of Paradise." The people exclaimed "God is greatest." Then he said: "I hope they will be a third of the people of Paradise." Then he said: "I hope they will be half of the people of Paradise." Then he said: "And seventy thousand will enter Paradise without reckoning." When they heard that, they said, "Who are these seventy thousand?" They discussed it among themselves and said, "They are a people who were born in Islam and never associated anything with God," until their talk reached the Prophet. He said: "They are those who do not seek spells, do not seek cauterization, do not take omens from birds, and rely on their Lord." A man stood and said, "O Messenger of God, ask God to make me among them." He said, "O God, make him among them." Another stood, and the Messenger of God said, "Ukasha has beaten you to it."

84 - وَأَخْبَرَنِي شَبِيبٌ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ: نَزَلَتْ عَلَيْهِ سُورَةُ الْحَجِّ وَهُوَ فِي مسيرٍ لَهُ يَتَعَشَّوْنَ مُتَبَدِّدِينَ، فَرَفَعَ بها صوته فنادى: {يا أيها النَّاسُ اتَّقُوا رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّ زَلْزَلَةَ السَّاعَةِ شيءٌ عظيمٌ يَوْمَ تَرَوْنَهَا تَذْهَلُ كُلُّ مرضعةٍ عَمَّا أَرْضَعَتْ وَتَضَعُ كُلُّ ذَاتِ حملٍ حَمْلَهَا وَتَرَى ⦗ص: 41⦘ النَّاسَ سُكَارَى وَمَا هُمْ بِسُكَارَى وَلَكِنَّ عَذَابَ الله شديدٌ}؛ فَاجْتَمَعَ إِلَيْهِ أَصْحَابُهُ فَقَالَ لَهُمْ: هَلْ تَدْرُونَ أَيَّ يَوْمٍ ذَلِكَ، ذَلِكَ يَوْمَ يَقُولُ اللَّهُ لآدَمَ: يَا آدَمُ، ابْعَثْ بَعْثًا إِلَى النَّارِ مِنْ بَنِيكَ وَبَنَاتِكَ، قَالَ: يَا رَبِّ، مِنْ كَمْ، قَالَ: مِنْ كُلِّ ألفٍ تِسْعَ مائةٍ وَتِسْعَةً وَتِسْعِينَ إِلَى النَّارِ وواحدٌ إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ؛ وَإِنَّ الْقَوْمَ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا ذَلِكَ أُبْلِسُوا وَكَبُرَ عَلَيْهِمْ، فَلَمَّا رَأَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا لَقَوْا قَالَ: أَبْشِرُوا، فَإِنَّكُمْ مَعَ خَلِيقَتَيْنِ لَمْ يَكُونَا مَعَ شَيْءٍ قَطُّ إِلا كَثَّرَتَاهُ يَأْجُوجُ وَمَأْجُوجُ، وَهُمْ مِنْ كُلِّ حدبٍ يَنْسِلُونَ، وَمَا أَنْتُمْ فِي النَّاسِ إِلا كَالرَّقْمَةِ فِي ذِرَاعِ الدَّابَّةِ أَوْ كَالشَّامَةِ فِي جَنْبِ البعير، ثم قال: إني لأرجوا أَنْ يَكُونَ مَنْ يَدْخُلُ مِنْ أُمَّتِي رُبُعَ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ، فَكَبَّرَ الْقَوْمُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: إِنِّي لأرجوا أَنْ يَكُونُوا ثُلُثَ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: إني لأرجوا أَنْ يَكُونُوا نِصْفَ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: وسبعون ألفاً يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ بِغَيْرِ حسابٍ؛ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَمَا سَمِعُوا ذَلِكَ قَالُوا: فَهَؤُلاءِ السَّبْعُونَ أَلْفًا مَا هُمْ، فَتَذَاكَرُوا بَيْنَهُمْ قَالُوا: هُمْ قومٌ وُلِدُوا فِي الإِسْلامِ وَلَمْ يُشْرِكُوا بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا، حَتَّى بَلَغَ النَّبِيَّ قَوْلُهُمْ، فَقَالَ: هُمُ الَّذِينَ لا يَسْتَرْقُونَ، وَلا يَكْتَوُونَ، وَلا يَتَطَيَّرُونَ، وَعَلَى رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَّكُلونَ؛ فَقَامَ رجلٌ فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي بَيْنَهُمْ، فَقَالَ: اللَّهُمَّ، اجْعَلْهُ مِنْهُمْ، فَقَامَ آخَرُ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: سَبَقَكَ بها عكاشة.

No. 85Vol. 1, p. 41

85. He said: Al-Harith ibn Nabhan informed me, from Ata ibn al-Saib, from Said ⦗p. 42⦘ ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, who said: "then We would have cut from him the aorta [watin]": He said, the nut of the heart (niyat al-qalb).

85 - قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي الْحَارِثُ بْنُ نَبْهَانَ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بن السائب عن سعيد ⦗ص: 42⦘ ابن جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ: {ثُمَّ لَقَطَعْنَا منه الوتين}، قَالَ: نِيَاطَ الْقَلْبِ.

No. 86Vol. 1, p. 42

86. He said: Al-Harith ibn Nabhan informed me, from Ata ibn al-Saib, from Said ibn Jubayr, on the words of God: "I almost conceal it": He said, He has [indeed] concealed it; "I almost conceal it from myself."

86 - قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي الْحَارِثُ بْنُ نَبْهَانَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بن السائب، عن سعيد بن جبير في قول الله: {أكاد أخفيها}، قال: لقد أخفاها إني أكاد أخفيها من نفسي.

No. 87Vol. 1, p. 42

87. He said: Shabib ibn Said informed me, from Aban, from al-Hasan, from Abu Hurayra, that the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, said one day: "O Abu Hurayra, you will remain safe as long as you do not go to three things: the wedding feast, the wager, and the shouting of the market." He said: "If you go to the wedding feast you become heedless and make others heedless, and if you go to the wager you swear and quarrel." He said, "And what is the shouting of the market?" He said: "The poet who recites poetry to the people; if you take three to ten steps toward him you are among the deviant." Then he recited this verse: "As for the poets, the deviant follow them."

87 - قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي شَبِيبُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبَانِ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ: يَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، إِنَّكَ لَنْ تَزَالَ سَالِمًا مَا لَمْ تَأْتِ ثَلاثًا: الْعُرْسَ، وَالرِّهَانَ وَصَيْحَةَ السُّوقِ، قَالَ: إِنَّكَ إِذَا أَتَيْتَ الْعُرْسَ غَفَلْتَ وَأَغْفَلْتَ، وَإِذَا أَتَيْتَ الرِّهَانَ حَلَفْتَ وَمَارَيْتَ؛ قَالَ: وَمَا صَيْحَةُ السُّوقِ، قَالَ: الشَّاعِرُ يُسْمِعُ الْقَوْمَ الشِّعْرَ، فَإِنْ خَطَوْتَ إِلَيْهِ ثَلاثَ خُطْوَاتٍ إِلَى عَشْرٍ كُنْتَ مِنَ الْغَاوِينَ؛ ثُمَّ تَلا هذه الآية: {والشعراء يتبعهم الغاوون}.

No. 88Vol. 1, p. 42

88. He said: Shabib ibn Said informed me, from Yahya ibn Abi Unaysa, that he asked ⦗p. 43⦘ Ata ibn Abi Rabah about the words of God: "Whoever comes with a good deed will have better than it, and they will be secure that Day from terror." Ata said: Whoever comes with the affirmation of God's oneness will have good and strength; "and whoever comes with an evil deed, their faces will be thrown into the Fire." Ata said: Whoever comes with polytheism. He said: I heard Ata say: Have you not heard His words "As for one who gives and fears God and believes in the best [reward]": He says, whoever affirms God's oneness; "and as for one who withholds and considers himself free of need and denies the best [reward]": he denies God's oneness.

88 - قال: وأخبرني شبيب بن سعيد عن يحيى بن أبي أنيسة أنه سأل ⦗ص: 43⦘ عطاء بن أبي رباح عن قول الله: {من جاء بالحسنة فله خيرٌ منها وهم من فزعٍ يومئذٍ آمنون}، قال عطاء: من جاء بالتوحيد فله خيرٌ وقوةٌ، {ومن جاء بالسيئة فكبت وجوههم في النار}، فقال عطاء: من جاء بالشرك؛ قال: وسمعت عطاء يقول: ألم تسمع لقوله: {من أعطى واتقى وصدق بالحسنى}، يقول: من صدق بالتوحيد، {وأما من بخل واستغنى وكذب بالحسنى}، كذب بالتوحيد.

No. 89Vol. 1, p. 43

89. He said: Al-Harith ibn Nabhan informed me, from Ata ibn al-Saib, from Amir: "or two others from other than yourselves": He said, from other than those who pray; and they will be made to swear after the afternoon prayer.

89 - قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي الْحَارِثُ بْنُ نَبْهَانَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بن السائب، عن عامر: {أو آخران من غيركم}، قال: من غير المصلين، فيستحلفان بعد العصر.

No. 90Vol. 1, p. 43

90. He said: Al-Harith ibn Nabhan informed me, from Ata ibn al-Saib, from Said ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, who said: "And in the earth are adjoining plots." He said: until he reached "and We make some of them better than others in produce": He said, white and black grapes, figs, peaches, cucumbers, and daqal in one land, watered with one water, ⦗p. 44⦘ sweet and sour. As for palms and "sinwan": five palms whose base is one.

90 - قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي الْحَارِثُ بْنُ نَبْهَانَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بن السائب، عن سعيد ابن جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ: {وَفِي الأَرْضِ قطعٌ متجاوراتٌ}، قَالَ: حَتَّى بَلَغَ: {وَنُفَضِّلُ بَعْضَهَا عَلَى بعضٍ فِي الأُكُلِ}، قَالَ: الْعِنَبُ الأَبْيَضُ وَالأَسْوَدُ وَالتِّينُ وَالْخَوْخُ وَالْقُوثِيَاءُ وَالدَّقَلُ فِي أَرْضٍ وَاحِدَةٍ وَتُسْقَى بِمَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ ⦗ص: 44⦘ حُلْوٌ وَحَامِضٌ، وَأَمَّا النَّخْلُ وَالصِّنْوَانُ الْخَمْسُ نَخْلاتٍ يَكُونُ أَصْلُهَا وَاحِدًا.

No. 91Vol. 1, p. 44

91. He said: Al-Harith ibn Nabhan informed me, from Ata ibn al-Saib, from Ibn Abbas, who said: "They guard him by the command of God": He said, he has attendants that guard him. He said, the angels, by the command of God, guard him.

91 - قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي الْحَارِثُ بْنُ نَبْهَانَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ: {يَحْفَظُونَهُ من أمر الله}، قَالَ: لَهُ معقباتٌ تَحْفَظُهُ، قَالَ: الْمَلائِكَةُ مِنْ أَمْرِ اللَّهِ يَحْفَظُونَهُ.

No. 92Vol. 1, p. 44

92. He said: Sufyan ibn Uyayna informed me, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Abd Allah ibn Abbas, that he used to recite: "He has attendants, before him" and guardians, "and behind him, by the command of God, they guard him."

92 - قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بن دينار، عن عبد الله ابن عَبَّاسٍ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقْرَأُ: {لَهُ معقباتٌ مِنْ بين يديه}، ورقباء، {من خلفه} من أمر الله {يحفظونه}.

No. 93Vol. 1, p. 44

93. He said: Al-Harith informed me, from Ghalib ibn Ubayd Allah, from Mujahid, on the words of God: "and We supported him with the Holy Spirit [ruh al-qudus]": He said, al-Quds is God.

93 - قال: وأخبرني الحارث عن غالب بن عبيد الله، عن مجاهد في قول الله: {وأيدناه بروح القدس}، قال: القدس هو الله.

No. 94Vol. 1, p. 44

94. He said: Al-Harith informed me, from Ghalib, from Mujahid, on the words of God: "and what they were constructing [yarishun]": He said, they were building dwellings.

94 - قال: وأخبرني الحارث، عن غالب، عن مجاهد في قول الله: {وما كانوا يعرشون}، قال: يبنون المساكن.

No. 95Vol. 1, p. 45

95. He said: Al-Harith informed me, from Ghalib, from Mujahid and Ata, on the words of God: "He will make for you a criterion [furqan]": They said, He will make for you a way out.

95 - قال: وأخبرني الحارث عن غالب عن مجاهد وعطاء في قول الله: {يجعل لكلم فرقانا}، قالا: يجعل لكم مخرجا.

No. 96Vol. 1, p. 45

96. He said: Ibn Wahb informed me, saying: And Mujahid said: "when a visitation [taif] from Satan touches them": He said, the mention of anger.

96 - قال: وأخبرني ابن وهب قال: وقال: مجاهد: {إذا مسهم طائفٌ من الشيطان}، قال: ذكر الغضب.

No. 97Vol. 1, p. 45

97. He said: Al-Harith informed me, from Ghalib, from Mujahid, on His words: "then there came after them successors": He said, the Christians.

97 - قال: وأخبرني الحارث، عن غالب، عن مجاهد في قوله: {فخلف من بعدهم خلفٌ}، قال: النصارى.

No. 98Vol. 1, p. 45

98. He said: Sad ibn Abd Allah al-Mafiri informed me, from Abu Mashar al-Qurazi ⦗p. 46⦘ who said: Whenever I heard something from the Companions of the Prophet, peace be upon him, I would look for it in the Qur'an and find it. God said to His Prophet: "Indeed, We have given you a clear conquest, that God may forgive you what preceded of your sin and what will follow, and complete His favor upon you." So I knew that God did not complete His favor on him until He forgave him. He said: Then I recited the verse in Sura al-Maida: "O you who believe, when you rise to prayer," until he reached "and to complete His favor upon you," so I knew that God did not complete His favor upon them until He forgave them.

98 - قال: وأخبرني سعد بن عبد الله المعافري، عن أبي معشر القرظي ⦗ص: 46⦘ قال: كنت إذا سمعت شيئا من أصحاب النبي عليه السلام التمسته في القرآن فوجدته؛ قال الله لنبيه: {إنا فتحنا لك فتحاً مبيناً ليغفر الله لك ما تقدم من ذنبك وما تأخر ويتم نعمته عليك}، فعرفت أن الله لم يتم عليه النعمة حتى غفر له؛ قال: ثم قرأت الآية التي في سورة المائدة: {يا أيها الذين آمنوا إذا قمتم إلى الصلاة}، حتى بلغ: {وليتم نعمته عليكم}، فعرفت أن الله لم يتم النعمة عليهم حتى غفر لهم.

No. 99Vol. 1, p. 46

99. He said: Yahya ibn Ayyub informed me, from Ubayd Allah ibn Zahr, from Sulayman, from Mujahid, from Ibn Abbas, who said: If one drop of "ghislin" fell on the earth, it would ruin the livelihoods of people; and if the Fire were brought out onto the open ground, nothing would pass by it without dying.

99 - قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَحْرٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ: لَوْ أَنَّ قَطْرَةً {من غسلينٍ}، وَقَعَتْ فِي الأَرْضِ أَفْسَدَتْ عَلَى النَّاسِ مَعَايِشَهُمْ، وَلَوْ أَنَّ النَّارَ أُبْرِزَتْ فِي صَعِيدٍ لَمْ يمر بها شيء إلا مات.

No. 100Vol. 1, p. 46

100. He said: Hafs ibn Maysara informed us, from Musa ibn Yasar, on the words of God: ⦗p. 47⦘ "Their sides forsake their beds": He said, between the maghrib and isha. Hafs said: And it has reached me, on the words of God "They used to sleep but little of the night," between the maghrib and isha: The Ansar used to pray the maghrib and then go off to Quba. Then it occurred to them [to change], and they stayed until they prayed the isha. So this verse was revealed concerning them: "They used to sleep but little of the night": between the maghrib and isha; "and in the hours before dawn they would seek forgiveness": they would set out from Quba and pray in the mosque of the Prophet.

100 - قال: وأخبرنا حفص بن ميسرة، عن موسى بن يسار في قول الله: ⦗ص: 47⦘ {تتجافي جنوبهم عن المضاجع}، قال: ما بين المغرب والعشاء. قال حفص: وبلغني في قول الله: {كانوا قليلا من الليل ما يهجعون}، ما بين المغرب والعشاء؛ كانت الأنصار يصلون المغرب فينصرفون إلى قباء فبدا لهم فأقاموا حتى صلوا العشاء، فنزلت فيهم هذه الآية: {كانوا قليلا من الليل ما يهجعون}، ما بين المغرب والعشاء، {وبالأسحار هم يستغفرون}، يغدون من قباء فيصلون في مسجد النبي.

No. 101Vol. 1, p. 47

101. He said: Hafs informed me, from Ibn Harmala, from Said ibn al-Musayyib, on the words of God: "for indeed He is ever forgiving to the awwabin": He said, the one who sins, then repents, and then God seals repentance for him.

101 - قال: وأخبرني حفص عن ابن حرملة، عن سعيد بن المسيب في قول الله: {فإنه كان للأوابين غفورا}، قال: الذي يذنب، ثم يتوب، ثم يختم الله له التوبة.

No. 102Vol. 1, p. 48

102. He said: Hafs ibn Maysara informed me, from Abu Mawdud, on the words of God: "for indeed He is ever forgiving to the awwabin": He said, between the maghrib and isha.

102 - قال: وأخبرني حفص بن ميسرة، عن أبي مودود في قول الله: {فإنه كان للأوابين غفورا}، قال: ما بين المغرب والعشاء.

No. 103Vol. 1, p. 48

103. He said: Men of knowledge informed me, among them Malik ibn Anas and al-Layth ibn Sad, from Yahya ibn Said, from Said ibn al-Musayyib, that he used to say about this verse: It is the servant who sins, then repents, then sins, then repents.

103 - قال: وأخبرني رجالٌ من أهل العلم منهم مالك بن أنس والليث ابن سعد، عن يحيى بن سعيد، عن سعيد بن المسيب أنه كان يقول في هذا الآية، قال: هو العبد يذنب، ثم يتوب، ثم يذنب، ثم يتوب.

No. 104Vol. 1, p. 48

104. He said: Abd al-Majid ibn Abd al-Aziz ibn Abi Rawwad related to us, from Uthman ibn al-Aswad, from Mujahid, on the words of God: "So he came out before his people in his adornment": [He came out] on white mounts whose saddles were crimson, and they wore saffron-dyed garments.

104 - قال: وحدثنا عبد المجيد بن عبد العزيز بن أبي الرواد، عن عثمان بن الأسود، عن مجاهد في قول الله: {فخرج على قومه في زينته}، على براذين بيض سروجهم الأرجوان وعليهم المعصفرات.

No. 105Vol. 1, p. 48

105. He said: Abd al-Majid related to me, from Ibn Jurayj, from Makhul, that he said ⦗p. 49⦘ on the words of God: "and when they are with him on a matter of collective concern, they do not depart until they have asked his permission": He said, the Friday prayer was one of those collective matters for which a man asks permission. He said, when that happened, the man would put his left hand over his nose, then come and gesture with his right hand to the imam, and the imam would gesture back to him, and he would leave.

105 - قال: وحدثني عبد المجيد، عن ابن جريج، عن مكحول أنه قال ⦗ص: 49⦘ في قول الله: {وإذا كانوا معه على أمرٍ جامعٍ لم يذهبوا حتى يستأذنوه}، قال: كانت الجمعة من تلك الأمور الجامعة التي يستأذن الرجل فيها، قال: إذا كان ذلك وضع الرجل يده اليسرى على أنفه، ثم يأتي فيشير بيده اليمنى إلى الإمام فيشير إليه الإمام فيذهب.

No. 106Vol. 1, p. 49

106. He said: Abd al-Majid related to me, from his father, from Yazid ibn Jabir, to that effect.

106 - قال: وحدثني عبد المجيد، عن أبيه، عن يزيد بن جابر بذلك.

No. 107Vol. 1, p. 49

107. He said: Umar ibn Qays informed me, from Muhammad ibn al-Murtafi, from Abd Allah ibn al-Zubayr, that he said: "By the dawn, and ten nights, and the even and the odd": He said, the dawn is an oath by which God swore; the ten nights are from the first of Dhu al-Hijja to the Day of Sacrifice; the even is the two days after the Day of Sacrifice; and the odd is the day of the second departure. God says: "Whoever hastens in two days, there is no sin upon him; and whoever delays, there is no sin upon him." "And the night when it passes": when ⦗p. 50⦘ it goes, one part following another.

107 - قال: وأخبرني عمر بن قيس، عن محمد بن المرتفع، عن عبد الله ابن الزبير أنه قال: {والفجر وليالٍ عشرٍ والشفع والوتر}، قال: الفجر: قسم أقسم الله به، وليال عشر: أول ذي الحجة إلى يوم النحر، والشفع: يومان بعد يوم النحر، والوتر: يوم النفر الآخر، يقول الله: {فمن تعجل في يومين فلا أثم عليه ومن تأخر فلا أثم عليه}، {والليل إذا يسر}، حين ⦗ص: 50⦘ يذهب يتبع بعضه بعضا.

No. 108Vol. 1, p. 50

108. He said: Umar ibn Qays informed me, from Ata ibn Abi Rabah, from Abd Allah ibn Abbas, that he said: The one ransomed was Ishmael. The Jews claim that it was Isaac, and the Jews lie.

108 - قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بن أبي رباح، عن عبد الله ابن عَبَّاسٍ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: الْمَفْدِيُّ إِسْمَاعِيلُ، وَزَعَمَتِ الْيَهُودُ أَنَّهُ إِسْحَاقُ، وَكَذَبَتِ الْيَهُودُ.

No. 109Vol. 1, p. 50

109. He said: I heard Sufyan al-Thawri relating, and I know it only from Mujahid, that he said: "It is He who sent among the unlettered a messenger from among them, reciting to them His verses": He said, the Arabs; "and others among them who have not yet joined them": the non-Arabs. "And this Qur'an was revealed to me that I may warn you by it": the Arabs, "and whomever it reaches": the non-Arabs.

109 - قال: وسمعت سفيان الثوري يحدث لا أعلم إلا عن مجاهد أنه قال: {هو الذي بعث في الأميين رسولا منهم يتلوا عليهم آياته}، قال: العرب: {وآخرين منهم لما يلحقوا بهم}، العجم، {وأوحي إلي هذا القرآن لأنذركم به}، العرب، {ومن بلغ}، العجم.

No. 110Vol. 1, p. 51

110. He said: Yazid ibn Yunus ibn Yazid informed me, from Abu Sakhr, who said: It has reached me from Abd Allah ibn Umar, on the words of God: "and they will not disobey you in what is right": He said, they will not tear their garments at the neck nor slap their cheeks. Abu Sakhr said: And I asked al-Qurazi, and he said: "and they will not disobey you in what is right" means that you may marry them or give them in marriage to whom you wish.

110 - قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ أَبِي صَخْرٍ قَالَ: بَلَغَنِي عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ فِي قَوْلِ اللَّهِ: {وَلا يعصينك في معروفٍ}، قَالَ: لا يَشْقُقْنَ جُيُوبَهُنَّ وَلا يَصْكُكْنَ خُدُودَهُنَّ. قَالَ أَبُو صَخْرٍ: وَسَأَلْتُ الْقُرَظِيَّ فَقَالَ: {وَلا يعصينك في معروفٍ}، أَنْ تَنْكَحَهُنَّ أَوْ تُنْكِحَهُنَّ مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَ.

No. 111Vol. 1, p. 51

111. And Yazid ibn Yunus ibn Yazid informed me, from Abu Sakhr, who said: It has reached me that Abd Allah ibn Umar was asked about the words of God: "and do not let them leave unless they commit a clear immorality": He said, their leaving their homes is an immorality. He said: And I asked al-Qurazi about it, and he said: Unless they go out for a penalty [hadd] they have incurred, so that it is carried out on them.

111 - وَأَخْبَرَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ أَبِي صَخْرٍ قَالَ: بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ سُئِلَ عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ: {وَلا يخرجن إلا أن يأتين بفاحشةٍ مبينةٍ}، قال: خُرُوجُهُنَّ مِنْ بُيُوتِهِنَّ فاحشةٌ. قَالَ: وَسَأَلْتُ الْقُرَظِيَّ عَنْهَا فَقَالَ: إِلا أَنْ يَخْرُجْنَ لحدٍ يَأْتِينَ بِهِ فَيُقَامَ عَلَيْهِنَّ.

No. 112Vol. 1, p. 52

112. He said: Yazid ibn Yunus ibn Yazid informed me, from Abu Sakhr, on the words of God: "Indeed, it throws sparks like a castle, as if they were yellow camels": He said, al-Qurazi used to say: Hell has a wall; what goes out beyond the wall of what returns into it is as large as castles and the color of tar.

112 - قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عن أبي صخر في قول الله: {إنها ترمي بشررٍ كالقصر كأنه جمالاتٌ صفرٌ}، قال: كان القرظي يقول: إن على جهنم سورا فما خرج من وراء السور مما يرجع فيها في عظم القصور ولون القار.

No. 113Vol. 1, p. 52

113. He said: Yazid ibn Yunus ibn Yazid informed me, from Abu Sakhr, from Abu Muawiya al-Bajali, from Said ibn Jubayr, from Abu al-Sahba al-Bakri, that he heard Abd Allah ibn Masud being asked about this verse: "And among the people is he who buys idle talk to mislead from the way of God." Abd Allah said: Singing. By Him other than whom there is no god, repeating it three times.

113 - قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ أَبِي صَخْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ الْبَجَلِيِّ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الصَّهْبَاءِ الْبَكْرِيِّ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مَسْعُودٍ وَهُوَ يُسْأَلُ عَنْ هَذِهِ الآيَةِ: {وَمِنَ النَّاسِ من يشتري لهو الحديث ليضل عن سبيل الله}، فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ: الْغِنَاءُ، وَالَّذِي لا إِلَهَ إِلا هُوَ، يُرَدِّدُهَا ثَلاثَ مراتٍ.

No. 114Vol. 1, p. 53

114. He said: A man informed me, from Amr ibn al-Harith, that Ata ibn Abi Rabah said, on the words of God: "Those, God will replace their evil deeds with good deeds": He said, this is only in this world: the man who is in an ugly state, and God replaces it with something better.

114 - قال: وأخبرني رجلٌ عن عمرو بن الحارث أن عطاء بن أبي رباح قال في قول الله: {فأولئك يبدل الله سيئاتهم حسناتٍ}، قال: إنما هذا في الدنيا، الرجل يكون على الهيئة القبيحة، ثم يبدله الله بها خيراً منها.

No. 115Vol. 1, p. 53

115. He said: Abd al-Rahman ibn Zayd ibn Aslam informed me, from his father, on the words of God: "then write it for them if you know in them any good": He said, "good" is the ability to do so. He said: "and give them from the wealth of God that He has given you": He said, that is from the zakat, by the rulers: they give them from the zakat, because of the words of God "and for [freeing] slaves."

115 - قال: وأخبرني عبد الرحمن بن زيد بن أسلم، عن أبيه في قول الله: {فكاتبوهم إن علمتم فيهم خيرا}، قال: الخير القوة على ذلك قال: {وآتوهم من مال الله الذي آتاكم}، قال: ذلك في الزكاة على الولاة يعطونهم من الزكاة لقول الله: {وفي الرقاب}.

No. 116Vol. 1, p. 53

116. He said: Ibn Zayd also related to me, from his father, on the words of God: "who are heedless of their prayer": He said, they pray, but prayer is not their concern, [they do it] for show. He said: ⦗p. 54⦘ "who show off and withhold small kindnesses": He said, they are the hypocrites who show off with their prayer and withhold the zakat of their wealth.

116 - قال: وحدثني أيضا ابن زيد عن أبيه في قول الله: {الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون}، قال: يصلون وليس الصلاة من شأنهم رياء؛ قال: ⦗ص: 54⦘ {الذين هم يراءون ويمنعون الماعون}، قال: هم المنافقون يراؤون بصلاتهم ويمنعون زكاة أموالهم.

No. 117Vol. 1, p. 54

117. He said: Abd al-Rahman ibn Zayd informed me, from his father, on the words of God: "except for the lamam": He said, it is what they had slipped into in the time of polytheism.

117 - قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أبيه في قول الله: {إلا اللمم}، قال: هو ما ألموا به في الشرك.

No. 118Vol. 1, p. 54

118. Abd al-Rahman ibn Zayd informed me, from his father, who said: "those who have incurred wrath": the Jews, "and those astray": the Christians.

118 - وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ قال: {المغضوب عليهم}، اليهود، {والضالين}، النصارى.

No. 119Vol. 1, p. 54

119. He said: Malik ibn Anas and Ibn Zayd ibn Aslam related to me that the one of whom God said "and a witness from the Children of Israel has testified to its like": He said, it is Abd Allah ibn Salam.

119 - قال: وحدثني مالك بن أنس وابن زيد بن أسلم أن الذين قال الله: {وشهد شاهدٌ من بني إسرائيل على مثله}، قال: هو عبد الله بن سلام.

No. 120Vol. 1, p. 55

120. He said: Malik and Ibn Zayd related to me, on the words of God: "and whoever has knowledge of the Book": They both said, it is Abd Allah ibn Salam.

120 - قال: وحدثني مالك وابن زيد في قول الله: {ومن عنده علم الكتاب}، قالا: هو عبد الله بن سلام.

No. 121Vol. 1, p. 55

121. He said: Khalid ibn Humayd informed me, from Uqayl, from Ibn Shihab, that this verse was revealed: "You were about to incline to them a little": [It was] when he was in Mecca, and when he circled the Kaba the polytheists would say to him, "Touch our gods, so that we do not harm you," or words like that. He almost did so, so God revealed about it what He revealed, forbidding him to incline to them even a little and warning him.

121 - قال: وأخبرني خالد بن حميد عن عقيل عن ابن شهاب أن هذه الآية أنزلت: {لقد كدت تركن إليهم شيئا قليلا}، أنه حين كان بمكة إذا طاف كان يقول له المشركون: استلم آلهتنا كي لا نضرك، أو نحو ذلك من الكلام، فكاد يفعل، فأنزل الله في ذلك ما أنزل ينهاه أن يركن إليهم شيئا قليلا وتواعده.

No. 122Vol. 1, p. 55

122. He said: Khalid ibn Humayd informed us, from Uqayl, from Ibn Shihab, that he used to say about this verse: "And do not make your hand chained to your neck, nor extend it with full extension": He says, do not withhold it from what is due and do not use it for what is false. ⦗p. 56⦘ "And those who, when they spend, are neither wasteful nor stingy": likewise.

122 - قال: وأخبرنا خالد بن حميد عن عقيل عن ابن شهاب أنه كان يقول في هذه الآية: {ولا تجعل يدك مغلولة إلى عنقك ولا تبسطها كل البسط}، يقول: لا تمنعه من حقٍ ولا تنفعه في باطلٍ، ⦗ص: 56⦘ {والذين إذا أنفقوا لم يسرفوا ولم يقتروا}، كذلك أيضاً.

No. 123Vol. 1, p. 56

123. He said: Khalid ibn Humayd informed me, from Uqayl, from Ibn Shihab, who said: Everything in the Qur'an that says "O people," unless it is a complete sura, was revealed by God in Mecca, and everything in the Qur'an that says "O you who believe" was revealed entirely in Medina, when the matter was firmly established.

123 - قال: وأخبرني خالد بن حميد عن عقيل، عن ابن شهاب قال: كل شيء في القرآن {يا أيها الناس}، ما لم يكن سورة تامة، فإنما أنزل الله ذلك بمكة، وكل شيء في القرآن {يا أيها الذين آمنوا}، فإنما أنزل كله بالمدينة حين استحكم الأمر.

No. 124Vol. 1, p. 56

124. He said: Khalid ibn Humayd informed me that it had reached him from Ibn Abbas, on the words of God: "Whatever good befalls you is from God, and whatever evil befalls you is from yourself": He said, this is the day of Uhud. He says: Whatever victory I opened for you is from Me, and whatever setback there was, I had decreed it upon you.

124 - قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي خَالِدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فِي قَوْلِ اللَّهِ: {مَا أصابك من حسنةٍ فمن الله وما أصابكم من سيئةٍ فمن نفسك}، قَالَ: هَذَا يَوْمُ أُحُدٍ، يَقُولُ: مَا فَتَحْتُ لَكَ مِنْ فتحٍ فَمِنِّي، وَمَا كَانَتْ مِنْ نكبةٍ، وَأَنَا قَدَّرْتُ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْكَ.

No. 125Vol. 1, p. 56

125. He said: Khalid ibn Humayd informed me, from one who told him, from Mujahid, from Ibn ⦗p. 57⦘ Abbas, that he used to say: "Indeed, in that are signs for those who discern": He says, for the perceptive. And Umar ibn al-Khattab used to say: The perceptiveness of the believer is a certain truth.

125 - قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي خَالِدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ ⦗ص: 57⦘ عَبَّاسٍ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يقول: {إن في ذلك لآياتٍ للمتوسمين}، يَقُولُ: لِلْمُتَفَرِّسِينَ؛ وَكَانَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ يَقُولُ: فِرَاسَةُ الْمُؤْمِنِ حقٌ يقينٌ.

No. 126Vol. 1, p. 57

126. He said: Abd al-Jabbar ibn Umar related to me that Ibn Abi Maryam related to him, saying: God called Noah "a grateful servant" only because when he relieved himself he would say: "Praise be to God, who made it pleasant for you [to enter], brought out of me its harm, and left in me its benefit."

126 - قال: وحدثني عبد الجبار بن عمر أن ابن أبي مريم حدثه قال: إنما سمى الله نوحا {عبدا شكورا}، أنه كان إذا خرج البراز منه قال: الحمد لله الذي سوغنيك طيبا وأخرج عني أذاك وأبقى في منفعتك.

No. 127Vol. 1, p. 57

127. He said: Abd Allah ibn Ayyash al-Qitbani related to me, from Umar, freedman of Ghufra, that the treasure that God mentioned in the sura in which He mentions the cave, "and beneath it was a treasure belonging to them," he said: it was a solid tablet of gold on which was written: In the name of God, the Most Gracious, ⦗p. 58⦘ the Most Merciful. I wonder at one who knows death, yet laughs; I wonder at one who is certain of destiny, yet toils [anxiously]; and I wonder at one who is certain of death, yet feels secure. I bear witness that there is no god but God and that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger.

127 - قال: وحدثني عبد الله بن عياش القتباني، عن عمر مولى غفرة أن الكنز الذي قال الله في سورة التي يذكر فيها الكهف: {وكان تحته كنزٌ لهما}، قال: كان لوحٌ من ذهبٍ مصمتٌ مكتوبٌ فيه: بسم الله الرحمن ⦗ص: 58⦘ الرحيم، عجبٌ ممن عرف الموت، ثم ضحك، وعجبٌ ممن أيقن بالقدر، ثم نصب، وعجبٌ ممن أيقن بالموت، ثم أمن، أشهد ان لا إله إلا الله وأن محمداً عبده ورسوله.

No. 128Vol. 1, p. 58

128. He said: Abd Allah ibn Ayyash informed me, from Zayd ibn Aslam, on the words of God: "And when the relatives, the orphans, and the needy attend the division, provide for them from it and speak to them kindly": The "division" is the bequest: God made for the deceased a portion of his wealth, which he bequeaths to whomever he wishes among those who do not inherit from him.

128 - قال: وأخبرني عبد الله بن عياش عن زيد بن أسلم في قول الله: {وإذا حضر القسمة أولوا القربى واليتامى والمساكين فارزقوهم منه وقولوا لهم قولا معروفا}، القسمة الوصية، جعل الله للميت جزء من ماله يوصي به لمن يشاء إلى من لا يرثه.

No. 129Vol. 1, p. 58

129. And Abd Allah ibn Ayyash said: Zayd ibn Aslam said, on the words of God: "If you avoid the major sins which you are forbidden, We will remove from you your minor misdeeds": Among the major sins are: polytheism, disbelief in the verses of God and His messengers, sorcery, killing children, whoever ascribes to God a son or a female companion, and the like of that of deeds and speech with which no deed is valid. ⦗p. 59⦘ As for every sin with which religion remains sound and deeds are accepted, God pardons evil deeds through good deeds.

129 - وقال عبد الله بن عياش: وقال زيد بن أسلم في قول الله: {إن تجتنبوا كبائر ما تنهون عنه نكفر عنكم سيئاتكم}، فمن الكبائر: الشرك، والكفر بآيات الله ورسله، والسحر، وقتل الأولاد، ومن دعا لله ولدا أو صاحبة، ومثل ذلك من الأعمال، والقول الذي لا يصلح معه عملٌ، ⦗ص: 59⦘ وأما كل ذنب يصلح معه دين ويقبل معه عملٌ فإن الله يعفو السيئات بالحسنات.

No. 130Vol. 1, p. 59

130. He said: Zayd said, on the words of God: "that He may recompense those who did evil for what they did, and recompense those who did good with the best": He said, those who did evil are the polytheists and those who did good are the believers.

130 - قال: وقال زيد في قول الله: {ليجزي الذين أساءوا بما عملوا ويجزي الذين أحسنوا بالحسنى}، قال: الذين أساؤوا هم المشركون، والذين أحسنوا: المؤمنون.

No. 131Vol. 1, p. 59

131. Ibn Ayyash said: Zayd said, on the words of God: "those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, except for the lamam": The major sins are polytheism, and the immoralities are fornication; they gave that up when they entered Islam, so God forgave them what they had slipped into and committed of it before Islam.

131 - قال ابن عياش: وقال زيد في قول الله: {الذين يجتنبون كبائر الإثم والفواحش إلا اللمم}، فالكبائر: الشرك، والفواحش: الزنا، تركوا ذلك حين دخلوا في الإسلام، فغفر الله لهم ما كانوا ألموا به وأصابوا من ذلك قبل الإسلام.

No. 132Vol. 1, p. 59

132. Ibn Ayyash said: Zayd said, on the words of God: "God is the light of the heavens and the earth; the example of His light...": His light is that of which the Qur'an speaks, and the example He gave for it is "light upon light," one part illuminating another.

132 - قال ابن عياش: وقال زيد في قول الله: {الله نور السموات والأرض مثل نوره}، ونوره الذي ذكر القرآن، ومثله الذي ضرب له نورٌ على نورٍ يضيء بعضه بعضا.

No. 133Vol. 1, p. 59

133. And Ibn Ayyash said: Zayd said, on the words of God: "[That light is] in houses which God has permitted to be raised ⦗p. 60⦘ and in which His name is mentioned; He is glorified therein morning and evening by men whom neither commerce nor sale distracts from the remembrance of God and the establishment of prayer and giving of zakat": [meaning] the upholding of the religion; and the day on which "hearts and eyes will turn about" is the Day of Resurrection.

133 - وقال ابن عياش: وقال زيد في قول الله: {في بيوتٍ أذن الله أن ⦗ص: 60⦘ ترفع ويذكر فيها اسمه يسبح له فيها بالغدو والآصال رجالٌ لا تلهيهم تجارةٌ ولا بيعٌ عن ذكر الله وإقام الصلاة وإيتاء الزكاة}، إقامة الدين، ويوم {تتقلب فيه القلوب والأبصار}، يوم القيامة.

No. 134Vol. 1, p. 60

134. Ibn Ayyash said: Zayd said, on the words of God: "And if two factions among the believers fight, make peace between them; and if one of them wrongs the other, fight the one that wrongs until it returns to the command of God": That is two men of the people of Islam fighting, or a group against a group, or a tribe against a tribe. God commanded the leaders of the Muslims to judge between them by the truth that God revealed in His Book, whether retaliation and the execution of qisas, or blood-money, or pardon. If one of them afterward wrongs the other, the Muslims are with the wronged against the wrongdoer, until it returns to the judgment of God and is satisfied with it.

134 - قال ابن عياش: وقال زيد في قول الله: {وإن طائفتان من المؤمنين اقتتلوا فأصلحوا بينهما فإن بغت إحداهما على الأخرى فقاتلوا التي تبغي حتى تفيء إلى أمر الله}، وذلك رجلان يقتتلان من أهل الإسلام، أو النفر والنفر، أو القبيلة والقبيلة، فأمر الله أئمة المسلمين أن يقضوا بينهم بالحق الذي أنزل الله في كتابه، إما القصاص والقود، وإما الغير، وإما العفو، فإن بغت إحداهما بعد ذلك على الأخرى كان المسلمون مع المظلوم على الظالم، حتى تفيء إلى حكم الله وترضى به.

No. 135Vol. 1, p. 60

135. Ibn Ayyash said: Zayd said, on the words of God: "And spend in the cause of God ⦗p. 61⦘ and do not throw yourselves with your own hands into destruction": That is because some men went out on expeditions the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, sent, without provision, and either they were cut off or they were dependents. So God commanded them to spend from what God had provided them and not to throw themselves into destruction. Destruction is for a man to perish of hunger, thirst, or walking. Then He said to the one who has surplus in hand: "and do good; indeed God loves the doers of good."

135 - قال ابن عياش: وقال زيد في قول الله: {وأنفقوا في سبيل الله ⦗ص: 61⦘ ولا تلقوا بأيديكم إلى التهلكة،} وذلك أن رجالا كانوا يخرجون في بعوثٍ يبعثها رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بغير نفقة، فإما يقطع بهم وإما كانوا عيالا، فأمرهم الله أن يستنفقوا مما رزقهم الله ولا يلقوا بأيديهم إلى التهلكة؛ والتهلكة أن يهلك الرجل من الجوع أو العطش أو من المشي؛ ثم قال لمن بيده فضلٌ: {وأحسنوا إن الله يحب المحسنين}.

No. 136Vol. 1, p. 61

136. Ibn Ayyash said: Zayd ibn Aslam said, on the words of God: "and those in whose wealth is a known right for the petitioner and the deprived": That is not the zakat, but is from what they spend of their wealth after paying the zakat. Zayd said: The "qani" is the one who asks people, and the "mahrum" is the one whose crop, tillage, or livestock offspring is struck, so that he has a right over those Muslims who were not struck. As God said of the owners of the garden when He destroyed their garden and they said "Rather, we are deprived [mahrumun]," and He also said: "If We willed ⦗p. 62⦘ We could make it debris, and you would remain in wonder: 'Indeed, we are burdened with debt. Rather, we are deprived.'"

136 - قال ابن عياش: وقال زيد بن أسلم في قول الله: {والذين في أموالهم حقٌ معلومٌ للسائل والمحروم}، وليس ذلك بالزكاة، ولكن ذلك مما ينفقون من أموالهم بعد إخراج الزكاة؛ قال زيد: {والقانع} الذي يسأل الناس، والمحروم الذي يصاب زرعه أو حرثه أو نسل ماشيته فيكون له حق على من لم يصبه من المسلمين؛ كما قال لأصحاب الجنة حين أهلك جنتهم فقالوا: {بل نحن محرومون}، وقال أيضا: {لو نشاء ⦗ص: 62⦘ لجعلناه حطاما فظلتم تفكهون إنا لمغرومون بل نحن محرومون}.

No. 137Vol. 1, p. 62

137. And Ibn Ayyash said: Zayd said, on this verse: "testimony among you," the whole verse: He said, that was about a man who died with no one of the people of Islam present. That was at the beginning of Islam, when the land was hostile and the people were disbelievers, except the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, and his companions in Medina and the people of Medina. People used to inherit by bequest; then the bequest was abrogated and the fixed shares of inheritance were made obligatory, and the Muslims acted upon them.

137 - وقال ابن عياش: وقال زيد في هذه الآية: {شهادة بينكم}، هذه الآية كلها، قال: كان ذلك في رجلٍ توفي وليس عنده أحدٌ من أهل الإسلام، وذلك في أول الإسلام، والأرض حربٌ والناس كفار إلا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وأصحابه بالمدينة، وأصحاب المدينة؛ وكان الناس يتوارثون بالوصية، ثم نسخت الوصية وفرضت الفرائض، وعمل المسلمون بها.

No. 138Vol. 1, p. 62

138. He said: And Zayd said, on this verse: "Not equal among you are those who spent before the conquest": He said, the conquest of Mecca.

138 - قال: وقال زيد في هذه الآية: {لا يستوي منكم من أنفق من قبل الفتح}، قال: فتح مكة.

No. 139Vol. 1, p. 62

139. He said: Abd Allah ibn Ayyash related to me, from Abu Sakhr, from Muhammad ibn Kab al-Qurazi, that Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz sent for him one day, when Umar was governor of Medina, ⦗p. 63⦘ and said: "O Abu Hamza, a verse kept me awake last night." Muhammad said, "What is it, O governor?" He said: The words of God: "O you who believe, whoever of you turns back from his religion, God will bring forth a people He loves and who love Him, humble toward the believers, firm against the disbelievers, striving in the cause of God and not fearing the blame of any blamer." Muhammad said, "O governor, by 'O you who believe' God meant only the rulers from Quraysh; 'whoever of you turns back' from the truth, 'God will bring forth a people,' and they are the people of Yemen." Umar said, "I wish that I and you were among them." He said, "Amen."

139 - قال: وحدثني عبد الله بن عياش، عن أبي صخر، عن محمد بن كعب القرظي أن عمر بن عبد العزيز أرسل يوما إليه، وعمر أمير المدينة يومئذٍ، ⦗ص: 63⦘ فقال: يا أبا حمزة، آيةٌ أسهرتني البارحة، قال: محمد: وما هي، أيها الأمير، قال: قول الله: {يا أيها الذين آمنوا من يرتد منكم عن دينه فسوف يأتي الله بقومٍ يحبهم ويحبونه أذلةٍ على المؤمنين أعزةٍ على الكافرين يجاهدون في سبيل الله ولا يخافون لومة لائم))، قال محمد: أيها الأمير، إنما عنى الله بـ {أيها الذين آمنوا} الولاة من قريش، {من يرتد منكم} عن الحق {يأتي الله بقومٍ}، وهم أهل اليمن؛ قال عمر: يا ليتني وإياك منهم، قال: آمين.

No. 140Vol. 1, p. 63

140. He said: Al-Qasim ibn Abd Allah related to us, from Abd Allah ibn Dinar, from Abd Allah ibn Umar, that he was asked about the "shafaq" and said: the disappearance of the white [glow]; and he was asked about the "ghasaq" and said: the disappearance of the red [glow].

140 - قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنَا الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنِ {الشَّفَقِ}، فَقَالَ: ذهاب البياض، وسئل عن الـ {غسق}، فَقَالَ: ذَهَابُ الْحُمْرَةِ.

No. 141Vol. 1, p. 63

141. He said: Ibn Abi al-Zinad informed me, from his father, who said: The Sabians ⦗p. 64⦘ are a people near Iraq, at Kutha. They believe in all the prophets, fast thirty days each year, and pray toward Yemen five prayers every day.

141 - قال: وأخبرني ابن أبي الزناد، عن أبيه قال: {الصائبون}، ⦗ص: 64⦘ قومٌ مما يلي العراق وهم بكوثى، وهم يؤمنون بالنبيين كلهم يصومون من كل سنةٍ ثلاثين يوما، ويصلون إلى اليمن كل يومٍ خمس صلواتٍ.

No. 142Vol. 1, p. 64

142. He said: Ibn Abi al-Zinad informed me, from Hisham ibn Urwa, from his father, that he used to say about this verse: "Take what is given freely, enjoin what is right, and turn away from the ignorant": Urwa said, God commanded His Messenger to take the easy, pardoning part of people's character. Hisham said: And my father used to say about this verse: "And none knows its interpretation except God, and those firmly grounded in knowledge say, 'We believe in it; all is from our Lord'": The firmly grounded in knowledge do not know its interpretation, but they say, "We believe in it; all is from our Lord."

142 - قال: وأخبرني ابن أبي الزناد، عن هشام بن عروة، عن أبيه أنه كان يقول في هذه الآية: {خذ العفو وأمر بالعرف وأعرض عن الجاهلين}، قال عروة: أمر الله رسوله أن يأخذ بالعفو من أخلاق الناس؛ قال هشام: وكان أبي يقول في هذه الآية: {وما يعلم تأويله إلا الله والراسخون في العلم يقولون آمنا به كلٌ من عند ربنا}، إن الراسخين في العلم لا يعلمون تأويله، ولكنهم يقولون آمنا به كل من عند ربنا.

No. 143Vol. 1, p. 65

143. He said: Ibn Abi al-Zinad informed me, from his father, who said: I heard from someone whose opinion is followed saying, on the "petitioner" and the "deprived": The deprived is the muharaf, who can scarcely turn to any trade without his provision being turned away from it.

143 - قال: وأخبرني ابن أبي الزناد عن أبيه قال: سمعت ممن اقتدى برأيه يقول في {السائل} و {المحروم}: إن المحروم الذي يحارف، لا يكاد يتوجه إلى شيءٍ من التجارة إلا نكب عنه الرزق.

No. 144Vol. 1, p. 65

144. He said: Ibn Abi al-Zinad informed me, from Hisham ibn Urwa, from his father, from Aisha, wife of the Prophet, who said: God revealed this verse about the woman who has reached old age and gives her day to another wife. About that was revealed: "there is no blame on them if they make terms of settlement between themselves."

144 - قال: وأخبرني ابن أبي الزناد، عن هشام بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ قَالَتْ: أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ هَذِهِ الآيَةَ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ إِذَا دَخَلَتْ فِي السِّنِّ فَتَجْعَلُ يَوْمَهَا لامرأةٍ أُخْرَى، فَفِي ذَلِكَ أُنْزِلَتْ: {فَلا جُنَاحَ عليهما أن يصلحا بينهما صلحاً}.

No. 145Vol. 1, p. 65

145. He said: Muslim ibn Khalid informed me, from al-Ala ibn Abd al-Rahman, from ⦗p. 66⦘ his father, from Abu Hurayra, that the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, recited this verse: "And if you turn away, He will replace you with another people, and they will not be the likes of you." They said, "O Messenger of God, who are these who will replace us if we turn away, and who will not be like us?" He struck the thigh of Salman al-Farisi and said: "This man and his people. If the religion were at the Pleiades, men from Persia would reach it."

145 - قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي مُسْلِمُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، عَنِ الْعَلاءِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ ⦗ص: 66⦘ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَلَى هَذِهِ الآيَةَ: {وَإِنْ تَتَوَلَّوْا يَسْتَبْدِلْ قوماً غيركم ثم لا يكونوا أمثالكم}، قَالُوا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، مَنْ هَؤُلاءِ الَّذِينَ إِنْ تَوَلَّيْنَا اسْتُبْدِلُوا بِنَا، ثُمَّ لا يَكُونُوا أَمْثَالَنَا؛ فَضَرَبَ عَلَى فَخِذِ سَلْمَانَ الْفَارِسِيِّ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: هَذَا وَقَوْمُهُ، لَوْ كَانَ الدِّينُ عِنْدَ الثُّرَيَّا لَتَنَاوَلَهُ رجالٌ مِنْ فَارِسَ.

No. 146Vol. 1, p. 66

146. He said: Sufyan ibn Uyayna and Muslim ibn Khalid related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on this verse: "And among the people is he who buys idle talk to mislead from the way of God without knowledge": He said, it is singing.

146 - قال: وحدثنا سفيان بن عيينة ومسلم بن خالد، عن ابن أبي نجيح، عن مجاهد في هذه الآية: {ومن الناس من يشتري لهو الحديث ليضل عن سبيل الله بغير علمٍ}، قال: هو الغناء.

No. 147Vol. 1, p. 66

147. He said: Abd al-Rahman ibn Zayd related to me, from his father, that the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, forbade reciting behind the imam in prayer. He said: That was when God revealed: "And when the Qur'an is recited, listen to it and be silent," and said: "And remember your Lord within yourself in humility and fear, and without loudness of speech, in the morning and evening, and do not be among the heedless." He said: Do not stand in prayer heedless. He said: And my father used to forbid recitation behind ⦗p. 67⦘ the imam in the strongest terms, both in what is recited silently and what is recited aloud.

147 - قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى أَنْ يُقْرَأَ خَلْفَ الإِمَامِ فِي الصَّلاةِ؛ قَالَ: وَذَلِكَ حِينَ أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ: {وَإِذَا قرئ القرآن فاستمعوا له وأنصتوا}، وَقَالَ: {وَاذْكُرْ رَبَّكَ فِي نَفْسِكَ تَضَرُّعًا وَخِيفَةً وَدُونَ الْجَهْرِ مِنَ الْقَوْلِ بِالْغُدُوِّ وَالآصَالِ وَلا تكن من الغافلين}، قَالَ: لا تَكُنْ قَائِمًا فِي الصَّلاةِ سَاهِيًا؛ قَالَ: وَكَانَ أَبِي يَنْهَى عَنِ الْقِرَاءَةِ خَلْفَ ⦗ص: 67⦘ الإِمَامِ أَشَدَّ النَّهْيِ، وَفِيمَا يُسِرُّ، وَفِيمَا يَجْهَرُ.

No. 148Vol. 1, p. 67

148. He said: Abd al-Rahman ibn Zayd ibn Aslam related to me that Umar ibn al-Khattab used to forbid that, and that Ali ibn Abi Talib used to forbid that and say: Whoever recites behind the imam has no prayer, and has departed from the sunna.

148 - قال: وحدثني عبد الرحمن بن زيد بن أَسْلَمَ أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ كَانَ يَنْهَى عَنْ ذَلِكَ، وَأَنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ كَانَ يَنْهَى عَنْ ذَلِكَ وَيَقُولُ: مَنْ قَرَأَ خَلْفَ الإِمَامِ فَلا صَلاةَ لَهُ، وَقَدْ خَرَجَ من السنة.

No. 149Vol. 1, p. 67

149. He said: Ibn Zayd related to me that Sad ibn Abi Waqqas used to say: I wish that his mouth had a burning ember in it.

149 - قال: وحدثني ابن زيد أن سعد بن أبي وقاص كان يقول: وددت أن في فيه جذلا من النار.

No. 150Vol. 1, p. 67

150. Abu al-Rabi said: Ibn Wahb related to us, saying: Usama ibn Zayd al-Laythi related to me, saying: I asked al-Qasim ibn Muhammad about reciting behind the imam. He said to me: If you recite, then a people with whom there is good example have recited, and you have followed the sunna; and if you abstain, then a people with whom there is good example have abstained, and you have followed a sunna, and Abd Allah ibn Umar did not recite.

150 - أبو الربيع قال: حدثنا ابن وهب قال: حدثني أسامة ابن زيد الليثي قال: سألت القاسم بن محمد عن القراءة خلف الإمام، فقال لي: إن قرأت فقد قرأ قومٌ بهم أسوة، وأخذت بالسنة، وإن تركت فقد ترك قومٌ بهم أسوة، وأخذت بسنة، وإن كان عبد الله بن عمر لا يقرأ.

No. 151Vol. 1, p. 67

151. He said: And I heard Ibn Wahb say: If he fears distracting thoughts, let him recite, in what ⦗p. 68⦘ the imam recites silently, whatever of the Qur'an is a supplication: "Our Lord, do not let our hearts deviate," the verse, or the like.

151 - قال: وسمعت ابن وهب يقول: إذا خاف الوسوسة فليقرأ فيما ⦗ص: 68⦘ يسر فيه الإمام فليقرأ ما فيه من القرآن دعاء: {ربنا لا تزغ قلوبنا}، الآية أو نحوه.

No. 152Vol. 1, p. 68

152. He said: He related to me that Abd Allah ibn Masud used to say: I wish that his mouth were stuffed with dirt.

152 - قال: وحدثني أن عبد الله بن مسعود كان يقول: وددت أن فاه حشي فيه التراب.

No. 153Vol. 1, p. 68

153. He said: Ibn Zayd related to me that Ubayy ibn Kab or Zayd ibn Thabit used to say: I wish his mouth were muzzled with a stone. They all used not to recite with the imam, neither in what is recited aloud nor what is recited silently, and they forbade that in the strongest terms.

153 - قال: وحدثني ابن زيد أن أبي بن كعب أو زيد بن ثابت كان يقول: وددت أنه مكعومٌ على حجرٍ؛ وإنهم كلهم كانوا لا يقرؤون مع الإمام فيما جهر ولا فيما أسر، وينهون عن ذلك أشد النهي.

No. 154Vol. 1, p. 68

154. He said: Bakr ibn Mudar related to me that Muhammad ibn Kab al-Qurazi used to say: There is an ambush before you, so take its passport; then he recited: "Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait, a place of return for the transgressors."

154 - قال: وحدثني بكر بن مضر أن محمد بن كعب القرظي كان يقول: إن بين أيديكم مرصدا، فخذوا له جوازه، ثم قرأ: {إن جهنم كانت مرصادا للطاغين مئابا}.

No. 155Vol. 1, p. 69

155. He said: Ibrahim ibn Suwayd wrote to me, saying: Zayd ibn Aslam related to me, on this verse: "O you who believe, when the call to prayer is made on Friday, hasten to the remembrance of God": He said, the call is when the imam comes out. He used to say: "Hastening" [sai] means working. God says: "Indeed, your efforts [saykum] are diverse," and said: "and whoever desires the Hereafter and strives for it with its due effort."

155 - قال: وكتب إلى إبراهيم بن سويد يقول: حدثني زيد بن أسلم في هذه الآية: {يا أيها الذين آمنوا إذا نودي للصلاة من يوم الجمعة فاسعوا إلى ذكر الله}، قال: النداء حين يخرج الإمام، وكان يقول: السعي العمل، إن الله يقول: {إن سعيكم لشتى}، وقال: {من أراد الآخرة وسعى لها سعيها}.

No. 156Vol. 1, p. 69

156. He said: A man related to me, from al-Muharrir ibn Hurayth, who said: In Yemen there were two towns, one called Hadura and the other Qilaba. He said: They became arrogant and lived in luxury until they did not even close their doors. He said: When they lived in luxury, God sent them a prophet who called them, and they killed him. God cast into the mind of Nebuchadnezzar to attack them, so he equipped an army against them. They fought them and defeated his army, and they returned to him defeated. He equipped another army, more numerous ⦗p. 70⦘ than the first, and they defeated them. When Nebuchadnezzar saw that, he attacked them himself, and they fought them and he defeated them until they fled from it at a run. They heard a caller saying: "Do not run, but return to the luxury you were given and to your dwellings." So they returned. Then they heard a voice saying: "O you with the blood-debts of the Prophet," and they were killed by the sword. That is what God said: "How many a town that was unjust did We break, and We produced after it another people. And when they felt Our might, they began to run from it. [It was said:] 'Do not run, but return to the luxury you were given and to your dwellings, perhaps you will be questioned.' They said, 'O woe to us, we were wrongdoers.' And that cry of theirs did not cease until We made them as a field reaped, extinguished."

156 - قال: وحدثني رجل عن المحرر بن حريث قال: كان باليمن قريتان يقال لإحداهما حضوراء والأخرى قلاثة، قال: فبطروا وأترفوا حتى ما كانوا يغلقون أبوابهم، قال: فلما أترفوا بعث الله إليهم نبياً فدعاهم فقتلوه؛ فألقى الله في نفس بخت نصر أن يغزوهم فجهز إليهم جيشا فقاتلوهم فهزموا جيشه، فرجعوا إليه منهزمين؛ فجهز إليهم جيشا آخر أكثف ⦗ص: 70⦘ من الأول فهزموهم؛ فلما رأي ذلك بخت بن نصر غزاهم هو نفسه فقاتلوهم فهزمهم حتى خرجوا منها يركضون؛ فسمعوا مناديا يقول: {لا تركضوا وارجعوا إلى ما أترفتم فيه ومساكنكم}، فرجعوا، فسمعوا صوتا يقول: يا آل ثأرات النبي، فقتلوا بالسيوف؛ فهي التي قال الله: {وكم قصمنا من قريةٍ كانت ظالمة وأنشأنا بعدها قوما آخرين فلما أحسوا بأسنا إذا هم منها يركضون لا تركضوا وارجعوا إلى ما أترفتم فيه ومساكنكم لعلكم تسألون قالوا يا ويلنا إنا كنا ظالمين فما زالت تلك دعواهم حتى جعلناهم حصيدا خامدين}.

No. 157Vol. 1, p. 70

157. He said: One who heard Uqayl ibn Khalid relating from Ibn Shihab related to me that he used to say: There is nothing but that it is in the Qur'an, except that we do not know it.

157 - قال: وحدثني من سمع عقيل بن خالد يحدث عن ابن شهاب أنه كان يقول: ما من شيءٍ إلا هو في القرآن إلا أنا لا نعرفه.

No. 158Vol. 1, p. 70

158. And one who also heard Uqayl ibn Khalid related to me that Abu Hurayra used to say, on this verse: "Indeed, in this is a message for a worshipping people": He said, they are those who pray the five prayers in the mosque.

158 - وحدثني أَيْضًا مَنْ سَمِعَ عَقِيلَ بْنَ خَالِدٍ أَيْضًا أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ كَانَ يَقُولُ فِي هَذِهِ الآيَةِ: {إِنَّ فِي هَذَا لَبَلاغًا لقومٍ عَابِدِينَ}، قَالَ: هُمُ الَّذِينَ يُصَلُّونَ الصَّلَوَاتِ الْخَمْسَ فِي المسجد.

No. 159Vol. 1, p. 70

159. He said: Ibn Lahia informed me, from more than one source, that a man had become a Muslim and attached himself to ⦗p. 71⦘ the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, who treated him kindly until he mixed with all his household. The believers and the polytheists heard of this and knew it about him. Then he joined the polytheists and said to them: "By God, I do not think anyone is more intimate with Muhammad than I." They said, "We have heard that, so tell us about him." He said: "By God, none teaches him but a slave of the Banu so-and-so, a shepherd and a foreign slave." So God revealed: "And We certainly know that they say, 'It is only a human being who teaches him.' The tongue of the one they allude to is foreign, and this is a clear Arabic tongue." This verse was revealed about that, and God knows best.

159 - قال: وأخبرني ابن لهيعة عن غير واحدٍ أن رجلا كان أسلم ولزم ⦗ص: 71⦘ رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ولطف به حتى اختلط بأهله كلهم، وأنه سمع بذلك المؤمنون والمشركون وعلم ذلك منه، وأنه لحق بالمشركين فقال لهم: والله، ما أرى أحدا أبطن بمحمدٍ مني، قالوا: قد سمعنا بذلك فأخبرنا عنه، قال: والله، ما يعلمه إلا عبد بني فلان، لراعي عبدٍ أعجمي، فأنزل الله: {ولقد نعلم أنهم يقولون إنما يعلمه بشرٌ لسان الذي يلحدون إليه أعجميٌ وهذا لسانٌ عربيٌ مبينٌ}، وفي ذلك أنزلت هذه الآية، والله أعلم.

No. 160Vol. 1, p. 71

160. He said: Ibn Lahia informed me, from Abu al-Aswad, who said: Two men brought a dispute to the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, and he ruled between them. The one against whom the ruling was given said, "Send us back to Umar ibn al-Khattab." The Messenger of God said, "Yes, go to him." When they came to Umar, the man said, "O son of al-Khattab, the Messenger of God ruled for me against this man, and he said, 'Send us back to Umar,' so he sent us back to you." He said, "Is that so?" The other said, "Yes." Umar said, "Stay where you are until I come out to you and judge between you." He came out to them wrapped in his sword and struck the one who had said "Send us back to Umar" and killed him. The other turned and fled to the Messenger of God and said: "O Messenger of God, by God, Umar has killed ⦗p. 72⦘ my companion, and if I had not outrun him he would have killed me." The Messenger of God said: "I did not think Umar would dare to kill a believer." So God revealed: "But no, by your Lord, they will not believe until they make you judge concerning what is in dispute among them, and then find in themselves no discomfort over what you have decided and submit completely." So the blood of that man was declared without recompense, and Umar was cleared of his killing, but God disliked that this become a practice afterward, so He said: "And if We had decreed upon them, 'Kill yourselves or leave your homes,' they would not have done it, except for a few of them; and if they had done what they were admonished to do, it would have been better for them and a firmer strengthening."

160 - قَالَ: وَأْخَبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي الأَسْوَدِ قَالَ: اخْتَصَمَ رَجُلانِ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَضَى بَيْنَهُمَا، فَقَالَ الَّذِي قُضِيَ عَلَيْهِ: رُدَّنَا إِلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: نَعَمْ، انْطَلِقَا إِلَيْهِ؛ فَلَمَّا أتيا عمر قال الرجل: يا ابن الْخَطَّابِ، قَضَى لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى هَذَا، فَقَالَ: رُدَّنَا إِلَى عُمَرَ، فَرَدَّنَا إِلَيْكَ؛ قَالَ: كَذَلِكَ، قَالَ: نَعَمْ، قَالَ عُمَرُ: مَكَانَكُمَا حَتَّى أَخْرُجَ إِلَيْكُمَا فَأَقْضِيَ بَيْنَكُمَا، فَخَرَجَ إِلَيْهِمَا مُشْتَمِلا عَلَى سَيْفِهِ فَضَرَبَ الَّذِي قَالَ: (رُدَّنَا إِلَى عُمَرَ)، فَقَتَلَهُ؛ وَأَدْبَرَ الآخَرُ فَارًّا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَتَلَ، ⦗ص: 72⦘ وَاللَّهِ، عُمَرُ صَاحِبِي، وَلَوْ مَا أَنِّي أَعْجَزْتُهُ لَقَتَلَنِي، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: مَا كُنْتُ أَظُنُّ أَنْ يَجْتَرِئَ عُمَرُ عَلَى قَتْلِ مؤمنٍ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ: {فَلا وَرَبِّكَ لا يُؤْمِنُونَ حَتَّى يُحَكِّمُوكَ فِيمَا شَجَرَ بَيْنَهُمْ ثُمَّ لا يَجِدُوا فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ حَرَجًا مِمَّا قَضَيْتَ ويسلموا تسليماً}، فَهُدِرَ دَمُ ذَلِكَ الرَّجُلِ وَبُرِّئَ عُمَرُ مِنْ قَتْلِهِ، وَكَرِهَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يُسَنَّ ذَلِكَ بَعْدُ، فَقَالَ: {وَلَوْ أَنَّا كَتَبْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ أَنِ اقْتُلُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ أَوِ اخْرُجُوا مِنْ دِيَارِكُمْ مَا فَعَلُوهُ إِلا قليلٌ مِنْهُمْ وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ فَعَلُوا مَا يُوعَظُونَ بِهِ لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَهُمْ وَأَشَدَّ تَثْبِيتًا}.

No. 161Vol. 1, p. 72

161. He said: Ibn Lahia informed me, from more than one source, that while Umar ibn al-Khattab was walking in the market of Medina, he passed a respectable woman standing among some rough men, bargaining over some goods, and he whipped her. She went until she came to the Messenger of God and said: "O Messenger of God, Umar ibn al-Khattab whipped me for nothing he had seen of me." The Prophet, peace be upon him, sent for Umar and said: "What made you whip your cousin?" He told him her story, and [Umar] said: "Is she my cousin? I did not recognize her, O Messenger of God; I did not see a cloak on her and thought she was a slave girl." The people said: "Now something will be revealed to the Messenger of God concerning what Umar said, and we do not have cloaks for our women." So God revealed: "O Prophet, tell your wives and your daughters and the women of the believers to draw their ⦗p. 73⦘ cloaks close over themselves. That is more suitable, that they be known and not harmed."

161 - قال: وأخبرني ابن لهيعة عن غير واحدٍ أن عمر بن الخطاب بينما هو يمشي بسوق المدينة مر على امرأةٍ محترمةٍ بين أعلاج قائمة تسوم ببعض السلع، فجلدها، فانطلقت حتى أتت رسول الله، فقالت: يا رسول الله، قد جلدني عمر بن الخطاب على غير شيءٍ رآه مني؛ فأرسل النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إلى عمر فقال: ما حملك على جلد ابنة عمك، فأخبره خبرها، فقال: أو ابنة عمي هي أنكرتها، يا رسول الله، إذا لم أر عليها جلبابا وظننت أنها وليدةٌ؛ فقال الناس: الآن ينزل على رسول الله فيما قال عمر وما نجد لنسائنا جلابيب، فأنزل الله: {يا أيها النبي قل لأزواجك وبناتك ونساء المؤمنين يدنين عليهن من ⦗ص: 73⦘ جلابيبهن ذلك أدنى أن يعرفن فلا يؤذين}.

No. 162Vol. 1, p. 73

162. He said: Makhrama ibn Bukayr related to me that he heard Zayd ibn Aslam say: The Bedouins used to come on Friday with sheep and ghee and sell them. He said: At the back of the mosque there was an open space, and when the people noticed them they stood up and went to them while the Messenger of God was preaching from the pulpit. So God revealed: "And when they see a transaction or a diversion, they rush to it and leave you standing. Say, what is with God is better than diversion and than a transaction, and God is the best of providers."

162 - قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنِي مَخْرَمَةُ بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ زَيْدَ بْنَ أَسْلَمَ يَقُولُ: كَانَ الأَعْرَابُ يَأْتُونَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ بِالْغَنَمِ وَالسَّمْنِ فَيَبِيعُونَهُ، قَالَ: وَكَانَ في مؤخر المسجد رحبة فكان إذا حسهم النَّاسُ قَامُوا إِلَيْهِمْ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ يَخْطُبُ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ: {وَإِذَا رَأَوْا تِجَارَةً أَوْ لَهْوًا انْفَضُّوا إِلَيْهَا وَتَرَكُوكَ قَائِمًا قُلْ مَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ خيرٌ مِنَ اللَّهْوِ وَمِنَ التِّجَارَةِ والله خير الرازقين}.

No. 163Vol. 1, p. 73

163. He said: Muawiya ibn Salih related to me, from Kathir ibn al-Harith, from al-Qasim, ⦗p. 74⦘ freedman of Muawiya, who said: The Messenger of God was asked about the "utull zanim," and he said: He is the foul, base person.

163 - قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ عَنْ كَثِيرِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ ⦗ص: 74⦘ مَوْلَى مُعَاوِيَةَ قَالَ: سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ عَنِ الْعُتُلِّ الزَّنِيمِ، قَالَ: هُوَ الْفَاحِشُ اللَّئِيمُ.

No. 164Vol. 1, p. 74

164. Muawiya said: And Iyad ibn Abd Allah al-Fihri related to me, from Musa ibn Uqba, from the Messenger of God, the same.

164 - قَالَ مُعَاوِيَةُ: وَحَدَّثَنِي عِيَاضُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْفِهْرِيُّ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ بِمِثْلِ ذَلِكَ.

No. 165Vol. 1, p. 74

165. He said: Sulayman ibn Bilal related to me, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Harmala, from Said ibn al-Musayyib, that he heard him say about this verse: "utull after that, zanim": Said said, he is the one who is attached to a people, though not of them.

165 - قال: وحدثني سليمان بن بلال عن عبد الرحمن بن حرملة، عن سعيد بن المسيب أنه سمعه يقول في هذه الآية: {عتلٌ بعد ذلك زنيم}، قال سعيد: وهو الملصق في القوم، ليس منهم.

No. 166Vol. 1, p. 74

166. He said: Ibn Lahia informed me, from Yazid ibn Abi Habib, from Abu Yusuf al-Mafiri, that Hanash ibn Abd Allah related to him that Kab al-Ahbar said: The "storming of the steep path" in the Book of God is seventy degrees in Paradise.

166 - قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أبي حبيب، عن أبي يوسف المعافري أن حنش بن عبد الله حدثه أن كعب الأحبار قال: إن اقتحام عقبة في كتاب الله سبعون درجة في الجنة.

No. 167Vol. 1, p. 74

167. He said: Shabib ibn Said informed me, from Shuba ibn al-Hajjaj, from Abu ⦗p. 75⦘ Ishaq, from Abu al-Ahwas and Hubayra, on this verse: "so they put their hands to their mouths": They said, like this, and he gestured with his fingers and put them in his teeth.

167 - قال: وأخبرني شبيب بن سعيد، عن شعبة بن الحجاج، عن أبي ⦗ص: 75⦘ إسحاق، عن أبي الأحوص وهبيرة في هذه الآية: {فردوا أيديهم في أفواههم}، قالوا: كذا، وأشار بأصابعه فأدخلها في أسنانه.

No. 168Vol. 1, p. 75

168. He said: Shabib ibn Said informed me, from Shuba, from al-Hakam, that Ali went out on the Day of Sacrifice on his mule, wanting to go to the open ground. A man came to him and took the bridle of his mount and asked him about the greater pilgrimage. He said: It is this day of yours; let go of it.

168 - قال: وأخبرني شبيب بن سعيد، عن شعبة، عن الحكم أن عليا خرج يوم النحر على بلغه يريد الجبانة، فجاءه رجلٌ، فأخذ بلجام دابته فسأله عن الحج الأكبر، فقال: هو يومك هذا، خل سبيلها.

No. 169Vol. 1, p. 75

169. He said: Shabib ibn Said informed me, from Aban, from al-Hasan, that the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, recited Sura al-Rahman until, when he reached its end, he said: "O company of humans, why do I see the jinn quicker to respond than you? Every time I recited to you 'So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?' they said, 'Not any of Your favors, our Lord, do we deny.'"

169 - قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي شَبِيبُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبَانِ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَرَأَ سُورَةَ الرَّحْمَنِ حَتَّى إِذَا أَتَى عَلَى آخِرِهَا، قَالَ: يَا مَعْشَرَ الإِنْسِ، مَا لِي أَرَى الْجِنَّ أَسْرَعَ إِجَابَةً مِنْكُمْ مَا قَرَأْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ: {فَبِأَيِّ آلاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ}، إِلا قَالُوا: لا بِأَيِّ شيءٍ، يَا رَبِّ، مِنْ نِعْمَتِكَ نُكَذِّبُ.

No. 170Vol. 1, p. 75

170. He said: Shabib informed me, from Aban, from Muslim ibn Abi Imran al-Asadi ⦗p. 76⦘ who said: Hudhayfa addressed the people at al-Mada'in and said: "The Hour has come near and the moon has split." Behold, the Hour has come near, and as for the moon, it has split. Behold, today is the training, tomorrow is the race; the goal is the Fire, and the first to arrive is [the one who reaches] Paradise.

170 - قال: وأخبرني شبيب، عن أبان، عن مسلم بن أبي عمران الأسدي ⦗ص: 76⦘ قال: خطب حذيفة الناس بالمدائن فقال: {اقتربت الساعة وانشق القمر}، ألا وإن الساعة قد اقتربت، وأما القمر فقد انشق، ألا إنما المضمار اليوم، والسباق غدا، الغاية النار، والسبق إلى الجنة.

No. 171Vol. 1, p. 76

171. He said: Shabib informed me, from Aban, from Abu Tamima al-Hujaymi, that he heard Abu Musa al-Ashari relating from the Messenger of God: On the Day of Resurrection God will send a caller who will call to the people of Paradise in a voice that the first and the last of them hear: "God has promised you the best and an increase." The best is Paradise, and the increase is looking at the face of God.

171 - قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي شَبِيبٌ، عَنْ أَبَانٍ، عَنْ أَبِي تَمِيمَةَ الْهُجَيْمِيِّ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيَّ يحدث عن رسول الله: إن الله بعث يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي أَهْلَ الْجَنَّةِ بصوتٍ يُسْمِعُ أَوَّلَهُمْ وَآخِرَهُمْ: إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَعَدَكُمُ الْحُسْنَى وَزِيَادَةً، فَالْحُسْنَى الْجَنَّةُ، وَالزِّيَادَةُ النَّظَرُ إِلَى وَجْهِ الله.

No. 172Vol. 1, p. 76

172. He said: Shabib informed me, from Aban, from Anas ibn Malik, from the Messenger of God ⦗p. 77⦘ that he said, when he was taken up to the sky: "I saw a river, swift as an arrow, streaming, whiter than milk and sweeter than honey, with domes of hollow pearl on its two banks. I said, 'O Gabriel, what is this?' He said, 'This is the Kawthar which your Lord has given you.' He said: I put my hand to its bank and it was fragrant musk. Then I put my hand to its pebbles, and they were pearl."

172 - قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي شَبِيبٌ، عَنْ أَبَانٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ⦗ص: 77⦘ أَنَّهُ قَالَ حِينَ عُرِجَ بِهِ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ، قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ نَهْرًا عَجَّاجًا مِثْلَ السَّهْمِ يَطَّرِدُ أَشَدُّ بَيَاضًا مِنَ اللَّبَنِ، وَأَحْلَى مِنَ الْعَسَلِ، حَافَتَاهُ قبابٌ مِنْ دُرٍّ مُجَوَّفٍ، فَقُلْتُ: يَا جِبْرِيلُ، مَا هَذَا، قَالَ: هَذَا الْكَوْثَرُ الَّذِي أَعْطَاكُمْ رَبُّكَ؛ قَالَ: فَضَرَبْتُ بِيَدِي إِلَى حَافَتِهِ فَإِذَا هُوَ مِسْكٌ ذَفِرٌ، ثُمَّ ضَرَبْتُ يَدِي إِلَى رَضْرَاضِهِ، فَإِذَا هُوَ درٌ.

No. 173Vol. 1, p. 77

173. He said: Al-Harith informed me, from Ayyub, from Ibn Abi Mulayka, from Aisha, who said: The Messenger of God said: "Whoever is closely examined in the reckoning on the Day of Resurrection is punished." She said, "Does God not say: 'then he will be judged with an easy reckoning'?" He said, "That is only the presentation."

173 - قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي الْحَارِثُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ: قَالَ رَسُولُ الله: مَنْ نُوقِشَ الْحِسَابَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عُذِّبَ، فَقَالَتْ: أَلَيْسَ قَالَ اللَّهُ: {فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًا يَسِيرًا}، فَقَالَ: إِنَّمَا ذَلِكَ الْعَرْضُ.

No. 174Vol. 1, p. 77

174. He said: Shabib ibn Said informed me, from Aban, from Abu Rafi, that he said: ⦗p. 78⦘ It has reached us that on the Day of Resurrection three ledgers will be brought for the son of Adam: a ledger containing good deeds, a ledger containing evil deeds, and a ledger containing blessings. The smallest of those blessings will be told: "Stand and take your price from the good deeds," and it will consume all of that deed, leaving his sins and the blessings as they were. Hence the servant says: "Indeed, our Lord is forgiving and appreciative."

174 - قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي شَبِيبُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبَانِ، عن أبي رافع أنه قال: ⦗ص: 78⦘ بلغنا أنه يجاء لابن آدم يوم القيامة بثلاثة دواوين: ديوان فيه الحسنات، وديوان فيه السيئات، وديوان فيه النعم، فيقال لأصغر تلك النعم: قومي فاستفي ثمنك من الحسنات، فتستوعب عمله ذلك كله، فتبقى ذنوبه والنعم كما هي، فمن ثم يقول العبد: {إن ربنا لغفورٌ شكورٌ}.

No. 175Vol. 1, p. 78

175. He said: Al-Harith ibn Nabhan informed me, from Ayyub, from a man, from Masruq or another, from Aisha, wife of the Prophet, who said: Whoever claims that Muhammad saw his Lord has made a monstrous charge against God. God said to Muhammad: "It is not for any human that God should speak to him except by revelation" (1), to the end of the verse. And whoever claims that Muhammad concealed any of the revelation has made a monstrous charge against God. God said: "O Messenger, convey what has been revealed to you from your Lord," to the end of the verse. And whoever claims that he knows what will be tomorrow has made a monstrous charge against God. God said: "Say, none in the heavens and earth knows the unseen except God, and they do not perceive when ⦗p. 79⦘ they will be resurrected."

175 - قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي الْحَارِثُ بْنُ نَبْهَانَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ رجلٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ أَوْ غَيْرِهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ قَالَتْ: مَنْ زَعَمَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَأَى رَبَّهُ فَقَدْ أَعْظَمَ عَلَى اللَّهِ الفرية، وقال الله لمحمدٍ: {ما كَانَ لبشرٍ أَنْ يُكَلِّمَهُ [اللَّهُ] (1) إِلا وَحْيًا}، حَتَّى خَتْمِ الآيَةِ، وَمَنْ زَعَمَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا كَتَمَ شَيْئًا مِنَ الْوَحْيِ فَقَدْ أَعْظَمَ عَلَى الله الفرية، وقال الله: {يا أيها الرَّسُولُ بَلِّغْ مَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِنْ رَبِّكَ}، حَتَّى خَتْمِ الآيَةِ، وَمَنْ زَعَمَ أَنَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي غدٍ، فَقَدْ أَعْظَمَ عَلَى اللَّهِ الفرية، وقال اللَّهُ: {قُلْ لا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ الْغَيْبَ إِلا اللَّهُ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ ⦗ص: 79⦘ يبعثون}.

Editor's note, p. 78

1. (1) Not in the printed edition.

1. (1) ليست في المطبوع.

No. 176Vol. 1, p. 79

176. He said: Al-Harith informed me, from Ayyub, from Ibn Abi Mulayka, from Aisha, wife of the Prophet, peace be upon him, who said: The Messenger of God recited this verse: "It is He who has sent down to you the Book; in it are precise verses, which are the foundation of the Book, and others unspecific," the whole verse. The Messenger of God said: "When you see those who follow what is unspecific of it, or those who dispute about it, they are the ones God described, so do not sit with them."
